transit.name: Core Transit Leadville Route
transit.detail: Morning northbound and evening southbound service. Serves Vail, Minturn, Red Cliff and Leadville. Fare required to or from Leadville.

nameOrigin.text: The U.S. Geological Survey says the name was probably chosen because lead was the major mineral in both the placers and the lode mines.

founded.text: The city of Leadville was founded in 1878

timeline.text: August R. Meyer built the Greek Revival clapboard house now called Healy House.
Horace Tabor built the Tabor Opera House in 100 days.
Horace Tabor bought the Matchless Mine on Fryer Hill on July 17 for $77,850.
The Victorian school building that now houses the National Mining Hall of Fame and Museum dates to 1899. It was once Leadville's high school.

sites.name: National Mining Hall of Fame and Museum
